page.overview:
Who is Alastair Christian Chim?

Master Alastair Christian Chim was a bartender at The Salusan Bull.

Alastair Christian Chim was approached by the Prisoner in the Matador Room in The Salusan Bull. He explained the rules of the establishment and asked them what they wanted to drink.
